physical.title: smoking-pipe
physical.summary:
Slip catalogue:
Pipe with thin bamboo stem and heavy bowl of black earthenware. The bowl is slightly bell-shaped and rises at right angles from the neck or socket which is long and thick. It is ornamented by transverse lines of deeply incised lozenge-pattern below the rim, and again after an interval the part where it joins the socket is ornamented by bands of shallow incised conventional design. The neck or socket has on its lower side five raised and rounded ridges (transverse), all of which are perforated to receive a cord, and is ornamented throughout its length by bands of long incised conventional pattern (zig-zag, cross) both longitudinal and transverse. There is a cord round the centre of the stem.
